official_text: Income Tax Department notice under section 133(6) asking for information regarding business receipts and bank transactions.

requests.original_text: Provide a month-wise summary of business receipts for FY 2023-24.

plain_language_explanation.en: Show how much your business received in each month.

requests.original_text: Provide the bank statement and explain the highlighted credits.

plain_language_explanation.en: Share the relevant bank record and explain the deposits marked in the notice.
